caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical device composed primarily of wooden and metal components. The base consists of two parallel, rectangular wooden beams with a smaller wooden beam connecting them near one end. Rising vertically from the joined end is an upright wooden frame with two vertical wooden pieces connected at the top by a horizontal wooden block, held together with visible bolts. Mounted within this frame is a set of intersecting metal gears colored in shades of brown and reddish brown, including a vertical toothed rod and circular cogwheels. Attached to the gears are several crank handles or levers extending outward horizontally and perpendicular to the frame. Two symmetrical, curved metal rods arch over the wooden base, attached to each side near the front. The drawing is executed with precise detail and rendered in naturalistic colors representing wood grain and oxidized metal, all set against a light, unadorned background. At the bottom, there is a small handwritten signature in black ink reading "J.L. Boyd."
title: Wheelwright's Drill
